verdict.rationale: Cursor provides analytics/insights APIs (Analytics API, AI Code Tracking API) that surface AI-usage metrics and accepted-edit data, and agents can generate summaries/artifacts (PR summaries, Bugbot findings) as a byproduct of code work, but there is no evidence of a dedicated 'AI-generated insights from your data' feature (e.g., analyzing business/user datasets and surfacing proactive suggestions) — Cursor's insight generation is scoped to code/repo/team-usage data, not general data analysis. missing for 10: evidence of insight generation over arbitrary/business datasets, proactive suggestion surfacing in a dashboard/UI beyond code review, independent validation of insight quality.
